Fulton Bank N.A. Has $21.57 Million Holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Posted by Dante Gardener | Jan 11th, 2018 
Fulton Bank N.A. lowered its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.3% during the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 139,986 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,894 shares during the period. Apple accounts for approximately 1.6% of Fulton Bank N.A.’s holdings, making the stock its 17th biggest holding. Fulton Bank N.A.’s holdings in Apple were worth $21,574,000 as of its most recent SEC filing. 
A number of other large investors also recently added to or reduced their stakes in AAPL. YHB Investment Advisors Inc. grew its stake in shares of Apple by 7.6% during the 2nd quarter. YHB Investment Advisors Inc. now owns 136,189 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $19,614,000 after purchasing an additional 9,663 shares during the period. Lederer & Associates Investment Counsel CA now owns 37,336 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,377,000 after acquiring an additional 779 shares during the period. Empirical Financial Services LLC grew its stake in shares of Apple by 23.9% during the 2nd quarter. Empirical Financial Services LLC now owns 21,558 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,105,000 after acquiring an additional 4,154 shares during the period. Carnick & Kubik Group LLC grew its stake in shares of Apple by 14.4% during the 2nd quarter. GenTrust LLC now owns 34,315 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,942,000 after acquiring an additional 31,259 shares during the period. Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ AAPL ) traded up $0.99 during midday trading on Thursday, reaching $175.28. 18,666,155 shares of the company’s stock traded hands, compared to its average volume of 26,940,000. Apple Inc. has a 12-month low of $118.21 and a 12-month high of $177.20. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73, a quick ratio of 1.23 and a current ratio of 1.28. The stock has a market cap of $899,940.00, a PE ratio of 19.07, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.43 and a beta of 1.23. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 2nd. The iPhone maker reported $2.07 EPS for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $1.87 by $0.20. Apple had a net margin of 21.09% and a return on equity of 36.29%. The business had revenue of $52.58 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $50.71 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the company posted $1.50 EPS. Apple’s revenue was up 12.2% on a year-over-year basis. equities research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.18 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
A number of brokerages recently issued reports on AAPL. Zacks Investment Research downgraded Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research note on Monday. UBS Group set a $190.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, January 5th. Bank of America reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, September 26th. Rosenblatt Securities reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and set a $150.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, September 21st. Finally, Barclays set a $162.00 price target on Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a report on Wednesday, January 3rd. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, nine have issued a hold rating, forty-one have issued a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company. Apple has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $198.70.

About Apple 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
